analyst_view.overall: Early view: two struggling sides, Levante 17th and Alavés 12th but without a win in five. Alavés have lost Facundo Garcés and Mikel Rodríguez to knee ligament injuries until April. I found little other news for this match, so the view rests mostly on form and those absences.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals. I lean slightly lower: both teams are low on confidence and near the bottom, which often makes for a cautious game, and Alavés have not won in five.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.9 corners. I found nothing on either side's style that moves this, so I stay with the model.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.3 cards. I lean a little higher: with both sides near the relegation places in December, I expect a tense, scrappy game with more fouls than usual.

shots.text: The numbers say 28.5 shots. Neither team is in Europe, so both should be fresh, and nothing in the news points clearly either way.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.6 shots on target. No clear reason to move away from the model this far out.
